workarounds.symptom: bug(gateway): a Codex subscription refuses every request that carries max_output_tokens
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(gateway): leave out the output limit on a Codex subscription. Target files: gateway/crates/pc-gateway-protocol/src/codex.rs, gateway/crates/pc-gateway-protocol/tests/subscription_protocol.rs, gateway/SUBSCRIPTIONS.md. On a Codex subscription the gateway refuses every model request that carries `max_output_tokens` with HTTP 403, because the endpoint rejects the field. The Codex CLI sends none, but Pi, DeepSeek Harness and OpenCode set an output limit on each request by default, so only the Codex CLI works on a Code... (Ref: https://github.com/oceanbase/powercontext/pull/2795)

workarounds.symptom: bug: model usage close() drops a batch it still has budget to drain (master unit red)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(usage): repeat an expired usage attempt while close() still drains. Target files: src/powercontext/builtin/runtime/_model_usage.py, tests/builtin/runtime/test_model_usage_recorder.py. `_ModelUsageRecorder.close()` sets `_closed` before it waits for the drain. Once `_closed` was set, `_write` never repeated an SQLite attempt that expired before its body committed. So during shutdown a batch got only its first slice, a quarter of `write_timeout_seconds` (0.25 s by default), even though `close()` waits up to `write_t... (Ref: https://github.com/oceanbase/powercontext/pull/2706)

workarounds.symptom: bug: configured E2E startup timeout leaves a live thread using its closed listener
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tests): finish Server cleanup after startup timeout.
